items.topic: What priority should this item have?
items.context: Currently set to priority 5 (lowest). If this is an important fix, the priority should be adjusted to ensure it gets processed in the right order relative to other backlog items.

options.label: Priority 1 — Critical, blocks other work
options.rationale: Use for items that block active development or cause production issues

options.label: Priority 2 — High, should be addressed soon
options.rationale: Important but not blocking immediate work

options.label: Priority 3 — Medium, standard queue position
options.rationale: Normal priority, processed in order

options.label: Priority 5 — Low, keep as-is
options.rationale: Nice to have, process when higher-priority items are done

items.topic: What file paths are expected to change?
items.context: No acceptance_allow or acceptance_deny fields are set. Once the target scenario is known (d2), we need to define the expected change boundaries for sandbox scoping and post-execution review.

options.label: Broad — entire target scenario directory
options.rationale: e.g., scenarios/<name>/** — use when the fix may touch multiple subsystems

options.label: Targeted — specific subdirectories only
options.rationale: e.g., scenarios/<name>/api/** — use when the fix is localized

options.label: Cross-scenario — multiple scenarios affected
options.rationale: Use when the fix spans shared code or multiple scenarios

options.label: Unknown — decide after problem is clarified
options.rationale: Defer until d1 is answered

items.notes: Pre-selected D because we cannot define file boundaries without knowing the problem and target scenario first.

items.topic: Should this item be converted to a different kind?
items.context: This is currently a 'fix' item, but with no description it's unclear if 'fix' is the right kind. The kind determines processing behavior — fixes expect a bug to reproduce and verify, ideas create new scenarios, execute items perform one-shot actions, etc.

options.label: Keep as fix
options.rationale: This is a bug or defect that needs to be corrected

options.label: Convert to idea
options.rationale: This is actually a new feature or scenario to build

options.label: Convert to execute
options.rationale: This is a one-time task to perform (migration, cleanup, etc.)

options.label: Convert to chore
options.rationale: This is maintenance work (dependency updates, refactoring, etc.)

options.label: Convert to research
options.rationale: This needs investigation before any implementation
